question: What radiant and wish-fulfilling images are invoked in this praise?
premises: The fruit of wish-fulfilling creepers is named.
A beautiful shining jewel-part is named.
Both are presented together as exalted images.
inference: The praise invokes the fruit of wish-creepers and a beautiful shining jewel-part.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of these accusatives in the larger hymn is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: The fruit of wish-fulfilling creepers and a beautiful, shining jewel-part.
